issues.description: OutputImageRawFrame is constructed with raw RGB bytes but declared format='RGB' from PIL Image that may not be RGB mode
issues.detail: image.tobytes() returns bytes in the image's current mode (could be RGBA, P, L, etc. depending on what Gemini returns), but the frame is hardcoded as format='RGB'. If Nano Banana returns PNG with alpha or a palette-mode image, downstream consumers will misinterpret the buffer, producing corrupted or wrong-sized frames. Should convert: image = image.convert('RGB') before tobytes().

issues.description: Monkey-patching genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE at module import is fragile and may break with SDK upgrades
issues.detail: Mutating a private attribute (_api_client) of google-genai at import time is brittle: the attribute path is not part of the public API, the pyproject now allows google-genai up to <2.0, and any minor change to the SDK's internal structure will raise AttributeError at import, breaking all Google services. The 'Temporary hack' comment acknowledges this. Needs guarded try/except or a proper SDK option.

issues.description: Default model change from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a silent breaking change
issues.detail: Existing users not pinning a model will be silently upgraded, which can change latency, cost, tool-calling behavior, and output style. This should at minimum be highlighted as a breaking change in CHANGELOG (currently filed under 'Changed' without warning), and ideally bump a minor version. Users relying on 2.0-flash semantics will be surprised.

issues.description: Image model detection by substring 'image' in model name is overly loose
issues.detail: The check `if 'image' in self._model_name` will match any future model name containing 'image' as a substring, including non-image-generation models with image input capability. A safer approach is an explicit allowlist of known image-output models or checking model capabilities. Could silently disable thinking budget for unrelated models.

issues.description: Example pipeline pushes image-generating LLM output through TTS, which has no image handling
issues.detail: In 07n-interruptible-gemini-image.py, the LLM produces OutputImageRawFrames that flow into the TTS stage and only reach transport.output() if TTS forwards unknown frames. With gemini-2.5-flash-image set as the model, the conversational TTS path may drop images or produce confusing behavior. The example should document expected frame routing or place image handling before TTS.

issues.description: Example appends a system message at on_client_connected, mutating the original messages list
issues.detail: messages.append({'role': 'system', ...}) inside on_client_connected mutates state captured by the LLMContext at construction time. Behavior depends on whether LLMContext copies or references the list; if referenced, repeated reconnects accumulate duplicate intro system messages. Minor but a common footgun worth fixing in an exemplar.

review.summary: PR adds image-generation support to GoogleLLMService via Nano Banana and an example. Two notable correctness issues: OutputImageRawFrame is built from image.tobytes() without converting the PIL image to RGB mode while declaring format='RGB', risking corrupted frames; and a module-level monkey-patch of a private genai attribute (_api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE) will silently break with any SDK internals change, especially given the loosened version range. Also, the default model change is a silent behavioral break, and image-model detection via substring matching is too loose. Example pipeline also routes image frames through TTS which is suspect.
